details: std's constant time modules (ct, rsa, bigmod, x25519, nistec, ed25519, mlkem) compile at -O2 even in a -O0 build (`xo test`'s default), so their masks stay in registers: at -O0, `rsa.pkcs1_unpad` kept them on the stack and its time followed the padding's zero byte on AMD Zen 5 and Apple silicon (decision 0619 step 4, the fallback where no DIT is).
changelog: - Security (xo build, LLVM at -O0): std's constant time modules (ct, rsa, bigmod, x25519, nistec, ed25519, mlkem) compile at -O2 even in a -O0 build (`xo test`'s default), so their masks stay in registers: at -O0, `rsa.pkcs1_unpad` kept them on the stack and its time followed the padding's zero byte on AMD Zen 5 and Apple silicon (decision 0619 step 4, the fallback where no DIT is).
